desc:
Cog is a cycling game that features fixies, road bikes, and mountain bikes.

Work as a delivery rider, earn money, and buy the bike that fits your style!
Choose from a variety of bikes and ride your way through the streets!

Available on PC, Console, and Mobile 💻🎮📱

Tips:
- You get 100 miles & 10,000 cash for every 10 minutes you play!
- Deliver Mails or take Uber Eats orders to earn money.
- Holding "Sprint" accelerates faster.
- FOLLOW THE OWNER AND LIKE THE GAME TO GET A FREE BIKE!👀

Pc Controls:
W - [Forward]
S - [Backward]
A - [Turn Left]
D - [Turn Right]
Z - [Fish and Chips Trick]
X - [Wheelie]
C - [Stand]
V - [Body View]
H - [Bike Hop]
LSHIFT - [Skid]
LCTRL - [Sprint]

Console Controls:
ButtonR1 - [Pedal]
ButtonL1 - [Brake]
LeftJoystick - [Steer]
ButtonX - [Fish and Chips Trick]
ButtonY - [Hop]
ButtonB - [Stand]
